title: The final build of the 3- and 10-page editions
headline: The final build is attached: both editions with every drawing in place. The 10-page edition now has the factory's stations, four scorecards and ruv-sgit's two strips. The storyteller's last pass took in every check: the bands security asked for, the quote back with its true speaker, the times as the record has them, and sources in plain names. Two checks run in the next half hour: security's clearance of the two new bands, and the researcher's full trace of the final text. I will say if either changes anything. One flaw is visible: sheet 5 of the 10-page edition holds only two lines that spilled over from the page before. The cover (CV2) and one word (RL1) are still yours.

for_you.ask: The 10-page edition's page 2 runs to two sheets
for_you.detail: The publisher: the scorecards are 112 by 110 mm with 9 pt text and don't fit beside the page's words. The fix is smaller cards with fewer values (the designer) or a page split.
for_you.recommend: Smaller cards, so the two spilled lines rejoin their page.

for_you.ask: Does the old ten-page sample live on?
for_you.detail: The editions supersede it. The historian's two findings on it wait on your word (the publisher's board 008).
